prompt: Show me the steps of the autonomous-drafting workflow.

text:
The **autonomous drafting** recipe is designed to take your existing story plan and turn it into actual chapters, drafting them one by one while pausing for your review.

Here is how the process works:

1.  **Preview Chapters:** I first look at your story plan to see exactly which chapters it will create. I'll tell you how many chapters are in the queue.
2.  **Create Chapters:** Once you've seen the preview, I'll ask for your permission to actually create those chapters in your book.
3.  **Set Up Drafting:** I'll prepare the drafting process, deciding which chapters to write and setting it to pause after each one so you can review the work.
4.  **Start Drafting:** I will ask for your final approval to begin the actual writing. This starts a background process where a specialized writing assistant drafts the chapters.
5.  **Monitor Progress:** I will watch the progress and keep you updated on what has been drafted so far.

**Important Note:** This recipe requires a **compiled story plan** to work. If you don't have a plan yet, we'll need to build and compile one before we can start drafting.

prompt: Show me the steps of the autonomous-drafting workflow.

text:
The **autonomous drafting** recipe is designed to take a completed story plan and turn it into actual chapters, drafting them one by one while pausing for your review.

Here is how the process works:

1.  **Preview Chapters:** I first look at your story plan to see exactly which chapters it will create. I'll tell you how many chapters are in the sequence.
2.  **Create Chapters:** Once you've seen the preview, I will ask for your permission to actually create those chapters in your book. This turns your plan into real, draftable chapters.
3.  **Set Up Drafting:** I will prepare the drafting process, deciding which chapters to write and whether I should pause after each one so you can review the work.
4.  **Start Drafting:** I will ask for your final approval to begin the actual writing. This starts a background process where a specialized writing assistant drafts the chapters.
5.  **Monitor Progress:** I will watch the progress and keep you updated on what has been drafted so far.

**Note:** This recipe requires a **compiled story plan** to work. If you don't have a plan yet, we'll need to build and compile one first.
